title: Core Experiment Poster System
description: Four reference-dependent images define a kids science-poster system across general setup, volcano chemistry, magnet exploration, and plant growth observation.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the poster grid, pictogram style, safety icon logic, and blank instruction panels. Images 02-04 preserve the same educational poster architecture while shifting the experiment topic.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01-reference-experiment-poster first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-volcano-reaction-board, 03-magnet-exploration-board, 04-seed-growth-board. Queue may run those images concurrently after 01-reference-experiment-poster is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
